name: Ride Me, Taxi Driver
detailed_description:
Story

A very special passenger has arrived—an elegant, alluring married woman.

What are the odds? You end up picking up your former crush! She's now a tsundere teacher.

Unbelievable! A rising political star just got in your car! Rumor has it she’s fleeing from the paparazzi...

At first, you thought it was just a series of chance encounters. But as time goes on, you realize each of them is hiding secrets they can’t afford to reveal.

The seemingly perfect marriage of the housewife? It may not be as blissful as it appears... Word is, her husband isn’t exactly satisfying her in certain ways.

The teacher keeps teasing you during the ride, but accidentally lets her guard down—now the hunter becomes the hunted.

With the election looming, the politician has all her cards in place. She’s prepared to do whatever it takes to win… including some very dirty tricks. Once you uncover her secrets, she might just become your personal plaything.

All three women are at critical turning points in their lives. Meeting you might just be their destined twist of fate.

Gameplay

[Garage]
Choose which passengers to pick up through the in-game app. Clear QTE (Quick Time Event) challenges to deliver them safely to their destinations.

[Ride QTE]
The road is full of surprises. As you drive, you’ll face various unexpected situations. Complete the QTEs to handle them skillfully.
Success earns you extra cash—and better reviews.

[Conversation]
Engage in dialogue to learn more about each female passenger—what they like, dislike, and what secrets they might be hiding.
As the game progresses, the conversations get deeper and more intimate.

[Customization]
Buy seat covers, air fresheners, hidden cameras, and more from the shop. Once installed in your car, these items change how events unfold.
Some can arouse the female passengers, while others help you capture... important footage.

[Intimate Encounters]
Earn enough trust and you’ll unlock special interactions with the ladies.
Park at a roadside spot, visit their workplace—or even enter their homes. The choice is yours.

Enjoy a variety of erotic scenes in different positions and settings, with charming SD characters and beautifully illustrated CGs—clear, close-up, and fully immersive.
